goal: Add a generic `migration-parity` guardrail to the base preset so migration-related changes must define behavior parity before implementation.

analysis.problem: Existing base guardrails require impact listing and compatibility awareness, but they do not explicitly require a must-level inventory, mapping, and behavior-level verification when existing public behavior is moved, split, extracted, replaced, or externalized.
analysis.proposedApproach: Add one base preset guardrail with id `migration-parity`, title `Migration Parity`, phase `draft` and `spec`, category `process`, and generic body text that excludes project-specific workflow plugin or board-item context.
analysis.validation: Issue #379 provides the target id, title, phase, category, body intent, excluded context, and implementation note to run `senti upgrade`; existing `src/presets/base/guardrail.json` contains comparable cross-cutting process guardrails.

knownFacts: must: Issue #379 states that Migration Parity Guardrail is generic and belongs in the base preset.
must: Existing base guardrails include cross-cutting process rules such as `single-responsibility`, `impact-on-existing-features`, and `req-diff-verifiability`.
must: The guardrail text must not include workflow plugin background, board item references, or other project-specific context because `src/` is distributed as an npm package.
decisionPoints: must: Add exactly one base guardrail entry for migration parity rather than creating a project-specific or plugin-specific rule.
must: Use `phase: ["draft", "spec"]` and `category: "process"` so the rule applies before implementation and during specification.
must: Keep `task-impl` out of scope for this change.
resolvedByProjectRules: must: Changing `src/presets/` requires running `senti upgrade` before completion.
must: Add one spec-local test file under `specs/289-migration-parity-guardrail/tests/` that fails before the `migration-parity` guardrail exists and passes after it is added.
must: Add or update one project regression test under `tests/unit/presets/base/` that reads `src/presets/base/guardrail.json` and asserts the new guardrail metadata and body concepts.
must: Guardrail prose should follow the base guardrail rewrite rubric where applicable: named violation, diff-verification conditions, and severity policy.
deferredToSpec: must: Specify exact acceptance criteria for the new guardrail metadata, body content, phase filtering, generic wording, upgrade artifact, and tests.
must: Decide whether the project regression test should extend `req-diff-verifiability-guardrail.test.js` or use a new sibling test file after checking existing base guardrail test patterns.

in: must: Add or update focused tests that verify the guardrail exists, has `draft` and `spec` phases only, uses `process`, and contains the required migration parity concepts.
must: Run `senti upgrade` after changing the base preset.
out: must: Do not include workflow plugin-specific background, board item identifiers, or repository-specific migration history in `src/` guardrail text.
must: Do not apply the new guardrail to `task-impl` in this change.
must: Do not change guardrail loader semantics unless tests reveal existing code cannot represent the requested metadata.

impactOnExisting: must: Existing guardrail loader behavior remains unchanged; this change adds one data entry consumed by the existing merge and phase-filter paths.
must: Existing base guardrail ids and metadata remain present; regression tests must check representative pre-existing ids are not deleted or renamed.
must: Projects using the base preset will receive one additional draft/spec guardrail after `senti upgrade` deploys preset updates.
